Maya: Hi team — I'm starting as an engineering manager next week. Dropping a tiny checklist so I can prioritize setup vs people stuff.

Olga: Welcome @Maya! Quick wins: get laptop + Duo done Day 0, schedule 1:1s Day 1, draft 30/60/90 Day 3.

Maya: Laptop ETA? any shortcuts if shipping delayed?

Ethan (IT): Order placed today. Standard ship 48h. If urgent, reply 'expedite' here and I'll prioritize. Also run /it-order in the portal with your shipping address.

Ravi (Security): For dashboard access complete Security Basics (15m) and sign the Access Acknowledgement. We require justification for prod-level roles. Tip: request read-only first.

Maya: Who should I add to my 1:1 list?

Olga: Start with direct reports, the tech lead, and your IC paired buddy. I'll DM a starter list.

Maya: Any week 1 must-do items to set with my manager?

Olga: Week 1 musts: confirm accounts + MFA, meet each direct report, schedule recurring 1:1s, draft measurable 30/60/90 goals to review with your manager.

onboarding-bot: Welcome folder created for Maya: https://drive.redwood.ai/onboarding/maya_manager (templates included).

Ethan (IT): Command example for asset request: /asset-request --user maya --item laptop --spec m3 --priority normal. Add phone for Duo.

Ravi (Security): Also enable disk encryption and enroll device in MDM on first boot. If using a personal device, request an exception.

Maya: Filing IT request and starting the security training now. Will update here once laptop + 1:1s done. Thanks!

Olga: Awesome. If anything blocks, tag me and we'll escalate in the ops sync. We'll do a 30/60/90 calibration at the end of week 4. :calendar:
